sentences.text: 07.11.2025 Heard Shri SC Biswas, learned counsel for the petitioner, who is aggrieved by the inaction of the Deputy Commissioner, Sonitpur (presently District Commissioner) in the representation dated 06.08.2024 made by the petitioner praying for reassessment of the compensation.

It, however, appears that the acquisition has been done under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 which itself provides for a reference to be made in accordance with law.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Be that as it may, issue notice, returnable by 4 weeks.

Ms. S Sarma, learned Standing Counsel, PWD accepts notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 1 and 5 whereas Shri N Goswami, learned State Counsel, Assam accepts notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 2, 3 and 4.
Extra copies of the writ petition along with its annexures be served upon the learned counsel for the respondents.
